items.title: Tether Froze $42.4 Million Three Months Before A Seizure Warrant, Lawsuit Says
items.summary: Two Thai businessmen are suing Tether in Manhattan federal court over 42,417,785.62 USDT blacklisted across 10 Ethereum addresses.

items.title: CFTC Asks Judge to Dismiss CME Lawsuit Over Crypto Perpetual Futures
items.summary: The regulator argues that CME cannot challenge its approval of Kalshi’s Bitcoin perpetual contract without showing concrete financial harm.

items.title: SoFi Links Banking Network and Stablecoin to Kraken in New Deal
items.summary: Kraken will list SoFiUSD and gain access to SoFi’s round-the-clock dollar settlement network, while Kraken Prime will execute trades for SoFi’s crypto customers.
